text:
alex: Quick heads-up — Datadog + OTLP HW compatibility sync. Wanted to align on the matrix and the dashboard bundle for the marketplace tile.
maya: +1. Are we focusing on GPU metrics (NVIDIA MIG, memory, SM util) or more on system-level traces first?
jon: We need both. HW partners want NV stats and traces linked to model requests. Suggest: OTLP trace -> Datadog APM span enrichment with gpu_id tag.
padma: Can someone draft the minimal OTLP attributes we need? I can take dashboard layout once attrs are defined.
alex: Draft attrs: resource.service.name, otel.resource.attributes.gpu.id, otel.metric.memory.usage, otel.metric.sm.util, net.request.latency_ms, model.name, model.version. Also sample trace span name: "inference.request".
maya: Nice. For Datadog tile we should include: 1) 99th latency per-model, 2) GPU memory pressure over time, 3) trace waterfall sample.
jon: Agreed. Also add trace sampling guidance: keep 1-5% by default, auto-increase to 100% for error rate > 0.5% for a given model.
elaine: FYI legal flagged that any joint announcement needs a 2-week review and logo guidelines from partner marketing. Can we target an internal preview next Wed?
padma: I can mock dashboard by Monday. Need sample OTLP metrics format. Can someone paste minimal YAML/OTLP example?
alex: Sure, here is a tiny exporter snippet we used in the demo:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/http:
    endpoint: https://ingest.redwood-observability.example/v1/otlp
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/http]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/http]
```
maya: And example metric payload (pseudo):
```json
{
  "resource": {"attributes": {"gpu.id": "gpu-01", "model.name": "rw-instruct"}},
  "metrics": [{"name": "gpu.memory.usage", "value": 8124, "unit": "MiB"}]
}
```
jon: For Datadog, mapping rules: map gpu.id -> tag "gpu_id", gpu.memory.usage -> gauge "redwood.gpu.memory_mb". I can create the DD mapping file.
padma: Great. Also need a short-runbook for SI: how to wire OTLP collector for air-gapped customers. Anyone drafted that?
elaine: Marketing wants 1-sheeter. Ops-bot will drop the checklist once we finalize attributes.
ops-bot: Generated checklist: [x] attributes list, [ ] dashboard mock, [ ] mapping file, [ ] SI runbook draft, [ ] announcement draft.
alex: Action items: jon -> DD mapping file (due Fri EOD), padma -> dashboard mock (Mon), maya -> sampling + agent config doc (Tue), elaine -> announcement timeline + legal (Fri).
maya: One more ask: HW partner asked about ingestion cost estimates. We should include token/metric rate estimates for a 100k qps model. Any guesses?
jon: Rough back-of-envelope: 100k qps is extreme — for summit demo use 5k qps baseline. For metrics: if we send 1 metric per inference + traces sampled at 2% with 4 spans -> estimate ~2.2M metrics/min and ~400k spans/min. We'll refine.
padma: ok I'll design dashboards for 5k qps baseline then scale notes.
elaine: Fine. I'll schedule the preview for next Wed 10am PT. Please update the checklist by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all. If anyone needs the sample tracing query for Datadog:
```
trace.search("service:inference AND span:inference.request", "@gpu_id")
```
jon: I'll post the mapping PR as soon as CI passes.
maya: leaving a quick note: we should include a small telemetry cost calculator for partners. I'll draft a spreadsheet template.
ops-bot: Reminder set for preview meeting: 2712353600 (next Wed 10am PT).
